name: FFS_KNOWLEDGE_URL_PARAM
description: Contains additional parameters required to access OKCS.

columns.name: ENTITY
columns.description: It is an identifier of the entity this parameters belongs to. If this value is not specified, the parameter can be available for several entities (like URL).

columns.name: PARAMETER_LABEL
columns.description: Oracle Knowledge name of the url parameter.

columns.name: FIELD
columns.description: Name of the field used as parameter value, or 'property' if property should be checked.

columns.name: PROPERTY_ID
columns.description: Reference to the property to be checked (if field = property).

columns.name: SORTING_ORDER
columns.description: It is an item sorting order inside of the same group.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
